summary: Verified Phase 1 of Merchant Dashboard Redesign (Tech Cyber Gold). Frontend-only Playwright testing on http://localhost:3000 in 390x844 mobile viewport with merchant credentials (0509999999/merchant2025). All 4 merchant screens (index/orders/products/more) render correctly with the new dark/gold theme, Bottom Tabs navigation is visible and switching works with 0 JS errors. Merchant Home: greeting + name + notif/logout icons, gold gradient hero card showing '0 ر.س' today with 'إجمالي: 82,489 ر.س' pill, 4 stat cards (طلبات نشطة=11, منتجات=6, عملاء=8, مسابقات=0), horizontal quick-actions row (6 tiles: add product, post, competition, banner, employee, support-settings), recent orders list (5 rows with #ID badge + status + amount). Orders screen: header '16 طلب • 0 جديد' + refresh icon, SegmentedControl with all 5 options (جديد/قيد التنفيذ/جاهز/مكتمل/الكل) with counts, empty state on 'جديد' filter (0 pending). Products screen: header '6 منتج • 0 نفدت • 0 منخفض' + gold + button, working search input, all 5 filter chips (الكل(6)/متوفر/منخفض(0)/نفد(0)/مميز) work — 'مميز' filter correctly shows only featured products, product cards show image+name+price+strike-through old price+stock switch+edit/delete buttons+badges. More screen: gold avatar 'Z' + name + phone, 3 grouped list sections (التسويق: 3 items, العمليات: 5 items, الإدارة: 3 items) + logout. All 11 More menu navigations tested and load their target screens without crash: social, competitions, banners, services, bookings, branches, drivers, delivery-settings, customers, employees, support-settings. Regression: Customer login (0500000000) → customer home (categories/hot products/banner) works, Driver login (0540001111) → /driver dashboard works. Total JS errors during merchant redesign flow = 0; only pre-existing 'Unexpected text node' warnings on /merchant/social (already documented in iteration_13, not touched by Phase 1). Non-fatal RN Web deprecation warnings observed for 'shadow*' style props, Image.resizeMode style, and props.pointerEvents — these come from RN Web layer/expo-linear-gradient and are not blockers but worth tracking for the RN Web migration path.

issues: Screen still shows English labels ('New Product', 'Name (Arabic) *', 'Price (SAR) *', category names in English) and uses the old light theme. Out of Phase 1 scope but visually inconsistent with new dark/gold merchant UI. Consider covering in Phase 2.
Still uses the OLD purple theme with English 'Customers (N)' header and 'orders' label. Reachable from the redesigned More menu but visually inconsistent. Out of Phase 1 scope.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' still fires ~12 times when opening /merchant/social (pre-existing, already documented in iteration_13.json). Reference: /app/frontend/app/merchant/social.tsx around lines 175/196/226-234/245-252. Not caused by Phase 1.

Console warnings on merchant screens: (1) 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — comes from shadows in /app/frontend/src/theme/tokens.ts (shadows.card/cardGold/header) applied via StyleSheet in ui/index.tsx and merchant/*.tsx. (2) 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' (3) 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-fatal on native, only affects RN Web preview. Consider updating shadow tokens to also provide boxShadow for web builds.

action_items: OPTIONAL / Phase 2 candidate: Redesign /merchant/product-form and /merchant/customers to use the new dark/gold tokens + Arabic labels for consistency with the redesigned tabs.
LOW / Optional: Address pre-existing 'Unexpected text node' warnings in merchant/social.tsx (unchanged since iteration_13).
LOW / Optional: Update /app/frontend/src/theme/tokens.ts shadows to also emit boxShadow so RN Web stops firing deprecation warnings, and switch Image.resizeMode from style to prop where used.
critical_code_review_comments: merchant/_layout.tsx correctly uses expo-router Tabs with 4 visible screens and hides 13 sub-routes via href:null. BlurView + gold tint + 68px height + 24px radius meet the described spec.

src/theme/tokens.ts is a clean, single-source design token file with dark surface (#0B0C10 / #15171E / #20232B), gold brand (#D4AF37), on-brand-primary black text, and semantic soft-fill colors — matches 'Tech Cyber Gold' spec, no blue/purple accents present.
src/components/ui/index.tsx (396 lines) is well below the 700-line threshold and exposes all 15 documented components. Haptics wrapped in try-catch (catch(()=>{})) so web preview does not crash.

merchant/index.tsx apiCall dependency array on useCallback is empty []; if apiCall identity changes on auth refresh, the initial load could go stale. Non-blocking as apiCall is stable across renders in the current AuthProvider.
merchant/products.tsx toggleStock does optimistic update and rollback on error — good pattern. Uses PUT /api/merchant/products/:id and passes full product body which is what the backend expects.
merchant/orders.tsx SegmentedControl generates counts memo-ized correctly; PrimaryButton/SecondaryButton with size='sm' are used in per-order actions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 4/4 tabs load, 11/11 More menu routes navigate, 0 JS errors on redesigned screens, regression (customer + driver) intact

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing merchant/customer/driver accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 merchant redesign is fully verified on web preview. If Phase 2 lands (product-form + customers + banners + etc. redesign), re-run the same navigation loop and also test: (1) product-form create flow end-to-end, (2) orders status transitions with real orders (there are 16 pending seeded), (3) verify boxShadow-based shadows once tokens are updated for RN Web. The 'Unexpected text node' warnings on /merchant/social are pre-existing and unrelated.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Phase 1 scope. One false-negative during the automated More-menu sweep (label 'العملاء' via .first matched a subtitle inside the الحجوزات ListItem because 'حجوزات العملاء للخدمات' contains the substring); direct navigation to /merchant/customers works and the ListItem itself wires correctly to the customers route. This is a test-selector limitation, not a product bug.
